summary: Deploy the new version with migration state_only so our SQL stages own the schema change, retire the old version, then apply a contract ALTER COLUMN to change account_user.note from TEXT to VARCHAR(255) — this avoids truncating old-version writes during concurrent traffic and satisfies the runner's value-equality checks at every checkpoint.
write_consistency: The new version writes notes limited to 255 chars via its CharField; the old version continues writing untruncated Text until retirement. After retire_old, the column is altered to VARCHAR(255) only when no concurrent writer exists, preserving existing note values and ensuring the runner's post-stage checks pass.

stages.description: Retire the old Saleor version after the new version has been running with the TEXT column.
Change account_user.note column type from TEXT to VARCHAR(255) using USCAST to preserve existing data without truncation errors.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN note TYPE varchar(255) USING note::varchar(255);
